title: LAV.ISH discloses the heavy hit single "Red Flag"
htmlContent:
Well known for his thought-provoking songwriter LAV.ISH has had his fair share of globetrotting. LAV.ISH has always amused his audience. He makes sure to showcase his talents in the release of his recent single Titled "Red Flags."

 The latest release, "Red Flags,” acknowledges that some people and things in this world are temporary. "Red Flag" is a perfect song that will mainly take you off-guard with its smooth sounds, but nothing takes away the shine of LAV.ISH performance, executing his perfect and well-imposed rhymes.
